description: Compartment composition of the LNP1 IntAct interactome and iteration-2 summary figure
code:
import requests, json, numpy as np, pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

partners = ["YWHAB","YWHAE","YWHAG","YWHAH","YWHAQ","YWHAZ","GAPDH","GLUL","AHCYL2",
            "PITRM1","NUDT12","PM20D2","GAN","NDUFAF5","TRPC4AP"]
rows=[]
for g in partners:
    try:
        r=requests.get("https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/search",
            params={"query":f"gene_exact:{g} AND organism_id:9606 AND reviewed:true",
                    "fields":"accession,gene_names,cc_subcellular_location,ft_transmem,go_c","format":"json","size":1},timeout=60)
        e=r.json()["results"][0]
        tm=len([f for f in e.get("features",[]) if f["type"]=="Transmembrane"])
        gos=[d["properties"][0]["value"] for d in e.get("uniProtKBCrossReferences",[])
             if d["database"]=="GO" and d["properties"][0]["value"].startswith("C:")]
        locs=[]
        for c in e.get("comments",[]):
            if c["commentType"]=="SUBCELLULAR LOCATION":
                for sl in c.get("subcellularLocations",[]):
                    locs.append(sl["location"]["value"])
        rows.append(dict(partner=g, acc=e["primaryAccession"], n_TM=tm,
                         ER_term=any("endoplasmic reticulum" in x.lower() for x in gos+locs),
                         membrane_term=any("membrane" in x.lower() for x in gos+locs),
                         cytosol_or_nucleus=any(("cytosol" in x.lower() or "nucle" in x.lower()) for x in gos+locs),
                         locations="; ".join(sorted(set(locs))[:4])))
    except Exception as ex:
        rows.append(dict(partner=g, acc="?", n_TM=None, ER_term=None, membrane_term=None,
                         cytosol_or_nucleus=None, locations="lookup failed: "+repr(ex)[:60]))
pt=pd.DataFrame(rows)
pd.set_option("display.width",250); pd.set_option("display.max_colwidth",60)
print(pt.to_string(index=False))
pt.to_csv("out/LNP1_interactome_compartments.csv",index=False)
print("\nPartners with >=1 TM helix: %d / %d" % ((pt.n_TM.fillna(0)>0).sum(), len(pt)))
print("Partners annotated to endoplasmic reticulum: %d / %d" % (pt.ER_term.fillna(False).sum(), len(pt)))
print("Partners annotated to cytosol or nucleus: %d / %d" % (pt.cytosol_or_nucleus.fillna(False).sum(), len(pt)))
print("LNPK (Q9C0E8) present in LNP1 interactome:", "LNPK" in partners)

# ---------- Figure for iteration 2 ----------
amp=pd.read_csv("out/LNP1_amphipathic_screen.csv")
pdb=open("out/AF-A1A4G5.pdb").read()
p=np.array([float(l[60:66]) for l in pdb.split("\n") if l.startswith("ATOM") and l[12:16].strip()=="CA"])

fig,ax=plt.subplots(1,3,figsize=(15,4.4))
a=ax[0]
cols=["#C0392B" if "LNP1" in x else "#5D6D7E" for x in amp.protein]
a.bar(range(len(amp)), amp.frac_windows_H_gt_0, color=cols)
a.set_xticks(range(len(amp))); a.set_xticklabels([x.split(" (")[0] for x in amp.protein], rotation=35, ha="right", fontsize=8)
a.set_ylabel("fraction of 18-aa helical windows\nwith mean hydrophobicity > 0")
a.set_title("No membrane-seeking helix in LNP1\n(6.2% of windows, vs 51% alpha-synuclein)", fontsize=9)

a=ax[1]
a.plot(np.arange(1,len(p)+1), p, color="#1F618D", lw=1.3)
a.axhline(70, ls="--", color="#F39C12", lw=1)
for s,e,lab in [(9,23,"9-23\nDDVSFAKWMSSFWGH"),(131,157,"131-157\nbasic/acidic helix")]:
    a.axvspan(s,e,color="#F9E79F",alpha=.6); a.text((s+e)/2, 95, lab, ha="center", fontsize=6.5)
a.set_ylim(0,105); a.set_xlabel("residue"); a.set_ylabel("pLDDT")
a.set_title("AlphaFold confident segments are 2 short\npolar helices, neither of TM character", fontsize=9)

a=ax[2]
cats=["partners with\n>=1 TM helix","partners annotated\nto ER","partners annotated\nto cytosol/nucleus"]
vals=[(pt.n_TM.fillna(0)>0).sum(), pt.ER_term.fillna(False).sum(), pt.cytosol_or_nucleus.fillna(False).sum()]
a.bar(cats, vals, color=["#5D6D7E","#5D6D7E","#C0392B"])
a.set_ylim(0,len(pt)); a.axhline(len(pt), ls=":", color="k", lw=1)
a.text(2.4, len(pt)*0.96, f"n = {len(pt)} partners", ha="right", fontsize=8)
for i,v in enumerate(vals): a.text(i, v+0.3, str(v), ha="center", fontsize=9)
a.set_ylabel("number of IntAct partners")
a.set_title("LNP1 interactome (BioPlex 3.0, PMID 33961781)\nis soluble, with no ER component", fontsize=9)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
